messages:
maria: Kicking off a compact window cutover for shard-42. Pinning runtime -> runtime@v2.3.1-rc2, router -> router@v1.9.4, api -> api@2026-03-15. Need quick ack on rollback thresholds and hold windows.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @maria. Preconditions: image hashes ok, infra quotas OK, dsync checks passed. Canary slice: 2% traffic -> shard-42.

dan: ack from console side. schema change is behind flag; we'll keep it off for now. Please watch console migration jobs.

kevin: noted. Recent perf test showed KV evictions spike under cold starts. Propose: rollback if p95 > 350ms OR error_rate > 4% sustained for 3m. :warning:

ashwin: watching router tail-drop and connection failures. I'll add a temporary fallback circuit to route to stable pool.

maria: release notes link: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/2026-03-15-cross-service-cutover - includes operator steps and postmortem template.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1745604380. Canary dashboard: http://deploymetrics.internal/canary/1745604380 (auto-refresh).

sre-bot: Alert policy: page if p99 latency increases >20% OR error_rate >3% over a 5m window. Pager duty: @oncall.

kevin: config snippet I'm using for the canary thresholds so it's explicit:

```
canary:
  traffic: 0.02
  checks:
    p50_latency_ms: < 120
    p95_latency_ms: < 320
    error_rate_pct: < 3
rollback_on:
  - p95_latency_ms: >= 350
  - error_rate_pct: >= 4
  - sustained_increase_window_mins: 3
```


dan: console team will hold schema rollout for +30m after canary green. We'll coordinate via this thread.

maria: running smoke tests against api/runtime/console now with the internal harness.

deploy-bot: Canary health update (1745604440): error_rate=0.6%, p95=145ms, runtime_cpu=68% — no abort flags.

ashwin: router tail-drop 0.02% and retries nominal. Suggest ramp to 10% in 10m if stable.

kevin: escalate plan documented: immediate rollback if any -> sustained error_rate > 3% for 5m, p99 increase >25%, or downstream KV throttle hits.

maria: consensus? If yes I'll approve ramp.

dan: +1 from console.

ashwin: +1. router fallback ready.

maria: ramp to 10% scheduled in 10m. Documenting pin in the rollout doc.

deploy-bot: Ramp start queued at 1745604470 -> target 10% by 1745605070. Rollback hook enabled.

ashwin: manual runbook for rollback: https://playbooks.internal/rollbacks/shard-42 (contains commands and contacts).

sre-bot: monitoring signal: p95 increased to 340ms for 3m (1745604465-1745604475) — trending upward, watching.

maria: holding ramp, do not progress to 10% until we have clarity. tagging oncall @kevin

kevin: investigating runtime GC spikes and a couple of kernel-level context switches. If error_rate crosses 3% in next 2m I'll trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: Auto-hook triggered: rollback executed at 1745604520. Rollback summary: runtime rolled back to runtime@v2.3.0, router traffic reverted to stable pools, api pinned back. Post-rollback health: error_rate and latencies returning to baseline.

maria: good call to hold. Filing quick postmortem notes and action items: increase canary pool size for better signal, add KV warm-up prior to ramp, coordinate console schema gating explicitly.

ashwin: will add the circuit adjustments and re-run small smoke after fixes.

kevin: I'll dig into GC tuning and KV client retry heuristics.

maria: thanks all — will share the postmortem doc once it's up. Closing thread once actions are tracked.
